basis_statement: One authoritative recovery tuple spans experience and workspace SSE streams even though route fields, sequence field names, and cursor artifacts differ.

notes: Experience streams stay mounted to one manifest route and one shell stability token.
Epoch changes force a full frame replacement instead of client-side stitching.
Workspace streams keep visibility posture, access binding, and masking explicit.
Route continuity stays subordinate to access and masking drift handling.

source_lineage.rationale: Maps the shared stream-recovery tuple to the corpus' two resumable SSE scope classes without inventing endpoint-local cursor law.
